entry.name: line~
entry.description: Use the line~ object to generate a signal ramp or envelope. It uses the Max time format syntax; envelope times can be either single valued fixed or tempo-relative.

arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the signal output. The default value is.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number specifies a target value and the second number specifies a total amount of time (in milliseconds) in whichshould reach the target value. In the specified amount of time,generates a ramp signal from its current value to the target value.accepts up to 128 target-time pairs in a list, to generate compound ramps. (An example would be, which would go from the current value to 0 in a second, then to 1 in a second.) Once one of the ramps has reached its target value, the next one starts. A subsequent,, orin the left inlet clears all ramps yet to be generated.A list consisting of a number, followed by a comma and up to 128 target-time pairs, will set an initial value for the ramp. An example would bewhich would set an initial value of 0, a new value of 1, and a target time of 1000 ms.In right inlet: A list may be used to specify time in one of the Max.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is the target value, to be arrived at in the time specified by the number in the right inlet. If no time has been specified since the last target value, the time is considered to be 0 and the output signal jumps immediately to the target value.In right inlet: The number is the time, in milliseconds, in which the output signal will arrive at the target value.

messages.description: In left inlet: The number is the target value, to be arrived at in the time specified by the number in the right inlet. messages.name: pause
messages.digest: Pause the internal ramp at its present location
messages.description: In left inlet: Pauses the internal ramp but does not change the target value nor clear pending target-time pairs.will continue outputting whatever value was its current value when themessage was received, until either it receives amessage or until a new ramp is input.

messages.name: resume
messages.description: In left inlet: Resumes the internal ramp and subsequent pending target-time pairs if theobject was paused as a result of themessage.

messages.name: stop
messages.digest: Stop the internal ramp and clear pending target-time pairs
messages.description: In left inlet: Stops the internal ramp and clears pending target-time pairs.will continue outputting whatever value was its current value when themessage was received, resetting its target value to that value.
